messages:
anya: Short rollup from the PM: recurring KV residency creep + tiny-frag retention. Need owners for immediate guardrails, diagnostics, and long-term fixes. Claim with one-line ETA.

mike: Ill take immediate guardrails: re-enable soft-cap 90% + tighten small-object eviction. ETA 2h; will push canary.

leigh: Ill own diagnostics: heap snapshots, flamegraphs, frag_ratio tile. Uploading artifacts to s3 and attaching to ticket PI-2472. ETA Mon.

sriram: Ill own allocator experiments: deferred-free canary and gc-threshold variants. RFC/experiment page by EOD Wed.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started by mike (deploy/kv-served v3.2.6-guard).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary healthy on 3/3 after 20m; residency down ~9%, no OOMs.

mike: Added alert: frag_ratio > 0.4 for 15m OR pooled_buffers > 5k triggers page. Runbook linked.

leigh: Initial heaps show many tiny buffers retained by put_batch and transport copy. frag_ratio ~0.43 on affected hosts. I'll attach flamegraph to PI-2472.

anya: Good. Also add a synthetic TestGrid job that skews small allocations. Owner: leigh. ETA Mon.

mike: I'll add per-shard eviction counters and a residency heatmap tile. ETA Thu.

sriram: If pool drain + caps don't help, prototype bounded pool with idle-drain; microbench by Wed.

anya: Thanks all. Keep updates one-line here; full writeup and artifact links go into PI-2472. Closing thread for short updates only. :memo:
